prompt.image: dark air-traffic control tower at night, green radar rings, paper flight strips, amber signal lights, glass and steel, cinematic top light, no text. Palette bg:#050b16, surface:#0c1a2b, paper:#e8eef5, accent:#7dffb2, warning:#ffb02e, stamp:#ff4d4d. Type NotoSansSC 700/900/Geist/Geist Mono. Motifs: radar ring, flight strip, runway light, signal lamp, glass. Composition: leave deliberate negative space for a headline; no readable text, no logos, no letters.
prompt.video: 救援: 乱局 → 诊断 → 修复 → 恢复 → 落版. Motion: radar sweep, strip slide, light blink, panel switch, hard cut. Transition: 扫描擦除. Captions: 页边注. Sound: 机械音. Hook pattern: 有些 [对象]，[动作] 完就再没被叫过。. Avoid the reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, transition combination, caption animation, motifs and SFX arrangement.
prompt.cover: 3:4 control tower poster, radar ring and flight strips, amber and radar green, top negative space, one strong signal light. Hook: 损失. Hero motif: radar ring. Brand block at bottom; keep key text in the top 75% and the right 120px clear. Render all text in HTML/SVG, not in the generated image.
